# **Packages and Setup**
***

We will begin by loading the packages that we will need. Several of these packages are available from CRAN (and packaged together as a part of the [tidyverse](https://tidyverse.org/packages/)) while others are available from Bioconductor, and one is best installed from GitHub.

```{r warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(here)
library(GEOquery)
library(magrittr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(sf)
library(arrow)
library(R.utils)
library(rhdf5)
library(Matrix)
library(spatialGE)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)
library(colorblindr)

```

Package        | CRAN, Bioconductor, or GitHub | Use
-------------- |------------- | --------------------------------------
[here](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/here/refman/here.html){target="_blank"} | CRAN | Constructs paths within a project
[GEOquery](https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/GEOquery.html){target="_blank"} | Bioconductor | Interact with GEO to fetch files
[magrittr](https://magrittr.tidyverse.org/){target="_blank"} | CRAN  (part of tidyverse) | Provides the pipe (`%>%`)
[tibble](https://tibble.tidyverse.org/){target="_blank"}  | CRAN  (part of tidyverse) | For special tables or data frames
[stringr](https://stringr.tidyverse.org/){target="_blank"} | CRAN (part of tidyverse) | For special string manipulation 
[readr](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/readr/refman/readr.html){target="_blank"} | CRAN (part of tidyverse) | Read and write rectangular data (like `.csv`, `.tsv`, etc.)
[dplyr](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/dplyr/refman/dplyr.html){target="_blank"} | CRAN (part of tidyverse) | Data wrangling
[tidyr](https://tidyr.tidyverse.org/){target="_blank"} | CRAN (part of tidyverse) | for wrangling data to get it to a "tidy" format
[sf](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/sf/refman/sf.html){target="_blank"} | CRAN | Enables storing and working with spatial data like polygon coordinates
[arrow](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/arrow/index.html){target="_blank"}) | CRAN | For working with parquet files
[R.utils](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/R.utils/index.html){target="_blank"} | CRAN | R utilities like duplicating variables
[rhdf5](https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/vignettes/rhdf5/inst/doc/rhdf5.html){target="_blank"} | Bioconductor | Reading and working with H5 files
[Matrix](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/Matrix/refman/Matrix.html){target="_blank"} | CRAN | Working with sparse and dense matrices
[spatialGE](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/spatialGE/refman/spatialGE.html){target="_blank"} | CRAN or [GitHub](https://github.com/FridleyLab/spatialGE/tree/main) | Package for QC, normalization, filtering, visualization, and analysis of spatially-informed gene expression data
[ggplot2](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/){target="_blank"} | CRAN (part of tidyverse) | For visualizing data
[purrr](https://purrr.tidyverse.org/){target="_blank"} | CRAN (part of tidyverse) | Methods for iterating on R objects
[ggpubr](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/ggpubr/refman/ggpubr.html){target="_blank"} | CRAN | Further functions to customize and prepare ggplot2 plots for publication
[patchwork](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/patchwork/refman/patchwork.html){target="_blank"} | CRAN | For combining multiple plots
[colorblindr](https://github.com/clauswilke/colorblindr){target="_blank"} | GitHub | for simulating color vision deficiency with real plots to evaluate if color palettes are distinguishable


The first time we use a function, we will use the `::` to indicate which package we are using. Unless we have overlapping function names, this is not necessary, but we will include it here to be informative about where the functions we will use come from.
